# appdimens-qt

> AppDimens for Qt 5.12+ and Qt 6: QML singleton `AppDimens` with 172 reactive factor properties (`width: 120 * AppDimens.sdp`), per-window `DimensScope`, Widgets `AppDimens::Scope` with responsive Qt Style Sheets (`padding: 16sdp`), C++ literals (`16_sdp`), per-monitor fractional DPR, DPI, rotation. Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, iOS, embedded. Version 3.2.0.

- [README](README.md) · [Guide](docs/GUIDE.md) · [Skill](skills/appdimens-qt/SKILL.md)
- Core: `include/appdimens/appdimens.h` (shared C99 core) · binding: `include/appdimens/appdimens_qt.hpp`
- Hub: https://github.com/bodenberg/appdimens
